variants.cockpit: Two-pilot glass flight deck with six display units, a side-stick on each outer console and the tray table in front of the pilot where a yoke would be. The thrust levers on the pedestal do not move with autothrust; the pilot sets a detent and the computers manage thrust below it.
variants.notes: In the simulators the ceo is flown as add-ons (FlyByWire-based or payware A320ceo in MSFS, ToLiss in X-Plane, FSLabs in P3D/FSX); MSFS ships the A320neo. The A319 and A321 share the flight deck. The side-stick priority latch time is given as 30 s or 40 s by different sources. Panels and detent conditions from public A320 FCOM / FlyByWire knowledge (no Airbus manual on this PC); the A330 X-Plane manual confirms the shared panel layout.

variants.cockpit: Two-pilot glass cockpit with HUDs, four large displays and yokes; the four power levers and the CNI keyboards sit on the pedestal between them. The J model needs no flight engineer.
variants.notes: From the DCS C-130J User Manual: Cockpit Overview (p. 13-19), Front / Side Yoke Controls (p. 63-64), Throttle Quadrant (p. 80), Cursor Hand Controller (p. 176). Pilot and copilot yokes are identical and interlinked. JoyPro seed rows for search / lock and unlock on the hand controller are not described in the manual and were left out.

overview.text: Two-pilot glass cockpit: HUDs and four HDDs, center console with CNI-MUs and power levers, two overhead panels; pilot left, copilot right with identical interlinked yokes; augmented crew seat behind the console.
